directions.name: Painted Coast
directions.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original art-direction concept for an interactive first-person 3D multiplayer soundscape called Sound of a City. Create one polished wide landscape concept image, not a collage and not a real photograph. All directions share this composition so they can be compared: eye-level view from a walkable timber boardwalk, an intimate cafe on the RIGHT with large open windows and a green awning, pine forest behind it on the right, open sandy beach and turquoise bay on the LEFT, a narrow timber pier in the far middle-left, distant simple headlands. The boardwalk leads forward into the middle distance. Two small original adult-proportioned anthropomorphic cat/dog visitors are in the middle ground, one holding a guitar by the cafe. The place feels calm, inhabited and explorable. Small translucent blue/green/amber concentric sound rings at three grounded positions indicate contributions left by visitors; these are secondary details, never huge magical effects. Show one restrained interface sample: a small readable bottom-center pill saying "Leave a sound", and an unobtrusive thin cream top margin with the direction label. Warm early-afternoon light in every option, visible shadows and gentle atmospheric depth. Design a coherent language across environment, vegetation, water, figures, sound rings and interface; this is a substantial re-art-direction rather than a color filter. Camera roughly 1.6 m above ground, 60-degree lens, no visible player body. Avoid photorealistic texture tiling, generic asset-store clutter, skyscrapers, islands floating in space, fantasy castles, neon cyberpunk, oversaturated bloom, a top-down dollhouse camera, franchise characters, brand logos, watermarks, or complex HUD panels. Exact title in the top margin: "A / PAINTED COAST". Art direction: a sophisticated hand-painted storybook world, watercolour and opaque gouache translated into walkable 3D. Architecture has slightly irregular warm plaster edges and simple handcrafted details. Pines have deliberately designed asymmetrical broad foliage silhouettes with overlapping painted masses, not stacks of cones. Paper-grain shadows, dry-brush foliage, simplified sand with large painted tonal shapes, sea as broad translucent teal brush bands and thin illustrated foam. Palette warm ivory, muted sage, ink-green, dusty peach and cerulean. Cat/dog figures are slender illustrated cutout-style characters with assured subtle linework and expressive clothes, in the same painterly material as the world. UI resembles a restrained cream field-journal tab with dark-green fine lettering. Nostalgic, lyrical, quiet, beautifully composed, adult-friendly rather than babyish. Clear readable space to walk; foreground and distant layers retain depth. Strongly visible brushwork and softly hand-inked contour accents distinguish this option.
